test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Ignoring his father’s warnings, he said,__ “an elephant in the room”__ to his mother.

options.text: The elephant got stuck in the room

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"an elephant in the room"** means there **is an obvious problem or issue** that everyone is aware of but no one wants to address. (कमरे में हाथी होना, स्पष्ट समस्या होना)

 
 
• **Example: **During the meeting, nobody mentioned the budget cuts, even though it was **the elephant in the room.**
 
 
 
• Ignoring his father’s warnings, he said, “**an elephant in the room**” to his mother.
 
 
• **Example: **Despite knowing the financial issues, they continued to ignore** the elephant in the room.**
 
 

Therefore, the correct meaning of the given idiom is **"There is an obvious problem."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: The elephant got stuck in the room** (हाथी कमरे में फंस गया)

 
 
• **Example: **This interpretation is literal and does not capture the idiomatic meaning.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: Someone begins to suspect** (कोई संदेह करने लगता है)
 
 
• **Example: **This option suggests suspicion but does not relate to the idiom's actual meaning.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: Someone hiding in the room** (कोई कमरे में छिपा हुआ है)
 
 
• **Example: **This is a literal interpretation and does not fit the idiom's context.
 
 

301:Tb48,

The correct answer is **Option 2)**
